mission_visits: Pioneer 5–11 — NASA, 1960s–70s (early interplanetary probes; solar wind + flares)
Helios 1 + 2 — NASA / DLR, 1974 / 1976 (closest perihelion of the era at 0.29 AU)
Skylab — NASA, 1973–74 (first crewed solar observatory; X-ray + UV imaging)
SMM (Solar Maximum Mission) — NASA, 1980–89 (flares, coronal mass ejections)
Yohkoh — ISAS / JAXA, 1991–2001 (X-ray + γ-ray solar imaging)
Ulysses — ESA / NASA, 1990–2009 (first polar solar orbit; high-latitude solar wind)
SOHO — ESA / NASA, 1995– (sun-pointing L1; coronal mass ejections, helioseismology, comet discoveries)
RHESSI — NASA, 2002–18 (hard-X-ray + γ-ray imaging of flare physics)
Hinode — JAXA / NASA / STFC / ESA, 2006– (chromosphere + transition region + corona spectrometry)
STEREO A + B — NASA, 2006– (twin spacecraft; first 3-D solar imaging)
SDO (Solar Dynamics Observatory) — NASA, 2010– (AIA full-disk every 12 s in 10 EUV bands)
IRIS — NASA, 2013– (chromosphere + transition region UV spectrometry)
Parker Solar Probe — NASA, 2018– (first spacecraft to fly through the corona; perihelia inside 10 solar radii)
Solar Orbiter — ESA / NASA, 2020– (combined high-res imaging + in-situ; out-of-ecliptic polar pass)
Aditya-L1 — ISRO, 2023– (India's first solar mission; L1 halo orbit)
